scope: Research experiment for restricted Gaussian AR replay. Fitted replay has fixed-K mild-persistence asymptotic justification, not a finite-sample or model-free guarantee. True-DGP replay and known-phi GLS are diagnostic oracles. No tuning after the full run.
random_stream: SeedSequence([stage_seed, 31, phase, group_id, replicate, purpose]); phase=0 calibration, 1 null evaluation, 2 power; purpose=0 observed Gaussian components, 1 inner Gaussian components, 2 independent score jitter. Inner batches partition one flattened Gaussian stream. Methods and power shifts share noise within a replicate; stages and groups are independent.
lags: floor(4*(T/100)^(2/9)), as in default_lags; fixed before data
fit: Common phi is the arithmetic mean of columnwise centered gamma1/gamma0, both divisor T. Raw rho is the mean off-diagonal Pearson correlation of centered columns; generator rho is its projection onto [0,1]. All projections are logged. The statistic always uses columnwise fitted phi, except frozen-factor ablation.
replay: Zero-mean stationary Gaussian common-factor generator; recompute centered HAC, columnwise fitted phi, finite-T tail correction, and maximum in every draw. replay_phi_fitted changes only temporal parameters; replay_rho_fitted changes only marginal factor rho; replay_fitted changes both. replay_frozen uses the fitted generator and freezes only observed columnwise correction factors. No invalid observation or draw is dropped.
monte_carlo_p: Inclusive (1 + number of inner maxima >= observed maximum)/(B+1). True-DGP rank reference is finite-sample conservative; fitted parameters do not preserve exchangeability. B+1 is a multiple of 20 in both profiles.

power.alternative: Only column 0 has mean delta*sqrt(true finite-T variance of its mean). Others are zero. Fits, centered scales and zero-mean reference draws are reused across shifts by exact translation invariance; each shift has its own observed maximum and winner.
power.size_matching: Independent null calibration, solely for simulation comparison. Analytic methods score statistic/nominal critical; rank methods score 1-p+U/(B+1), U uniform and independent of data/draws. Jitter breaks discrete score ties and never changes reported p. Select ordered calibration score at rank ceil((1-alpha)*(M+1)); reject above this fixed score in independent evaluation/power stages. If rank <= M, unconditional calibration size is (M+1-rank)/(M+1), and conditional tail probability has Beta(M+1-rank,rank) law. This is an oracle simulation comparison, not an implementable calibration for unknown data-generating laws.
power.selection: Report global rejection and rejection with the maximizing candidate equal to column 0. A maximum test alone does not provide simultaneous identification of each profitable strategy.

assessment.primary: Report fitted replay size in all six correctly specified cells, without selecting a method from results. A cell clears the prespecified 7% tolerance only if its one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper limit, with error probability 0.05/6, is <= 0.07. This is a finite experiment screen, not a theorem or certification outside these cells.
assessment.intervals: Wilson 95% pointwise intervals for rejection/power. Paired discordance, risk difference and exact McNemar p are descriptive. Paired risk-difference intervals use the normal variance of {-1,0,1} differences. Power shifts and methods are paired and are not independent trials.
assessment.stress: Cell 7 deliberately violates the common temporal coefficient: common factor phi=.98, idiosyncratic phi=.30. Its instantaneous rho=.35 differs from correlation of sample means. Known-phi GLS is not applicable and is omitted, not replaced by a fitted version.
assessment.limits: No heavy-tail, arbitrary covariance, growing-K fitted-bootstrap or local-unit uniform validity claim. K=100 is an empirical stress cell; the supplied fitted-bootstrap proof is fixed K. No hyperparameter sweep or result-dependent exclusions.
